claims.claim: Cleopatra lived closer to the Moon landing than to its building.

Holds on every chronology given.

claims.claim: Among them was the logbook of Merer's boat crew, hauling limestone from a quarry seventeen kilometres away to the pyramid.
claims.source_checked: Tallet & Marouard, Near Eastern Archaeology 77(1): 4-14 (2014), doi:10.5615/neareastarch.77.1.0004 (DOI/title checked on api.crossref.org): full text at archive.org/stream/theharborofkhufuontheredseacoastatwadialjarfegypt (_djvu.txt) pp. 8-10; Sheisha et al., PNAS 119(37): e2202530119 (2022), doi:10.1073/pnas.2202530119: full text at pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC9477388/
